name: backgrounds-batch1
goal: 1차 배경 배치 — 김밥·카페·초밥 테마 씬. 골든 톤 앵커. 중앙~하단은 게임플레이 영역이므로 비워두고(저대비), 배경이 오브젝트 판독성을 해치지 않아야 함.
style: bold clean dark outlines on foreground shapes, vibrant but slightly desaturated background palette so gameplay objects pop, energetic comic cartoon style, flat cel shading
common: portrait 1024x1536 game background scene filling the whole frame (no transparency), uncluttered low-contrast center and lower area reserved for gameplay, no text, no watermark, no characters, no people

items.label: 분식집 배경
items.subject: the interior counter of a cozy Korean snack diner (bunsikjip): warm wood counter, menu-less walls, steam pots in the far background

items.label: 초밥집 배경
items.subject: a sushi restaurant counter scene: dark teal walls, wooden sushi bar counter in the foreground, subtle japanese lanterns in the far background

items.subject: a warm cafe bar counter scene: wooden counter, espresso machine silhouette to one side in the background, warm brown tones
